――それから長い眠りの果てに、俺の意識が闇の底から浮かび上がる。: —Then, after a long slumber, my consciousness slowly surfaces from the depths of darkness.
視界はぼやけ、身体の感覚さえ遠い。\n思考は霧に包まれたように、まるでまとまらな:
My vision is blurry, and even the sensations in my body feel distant.
My thoughts are shrouded in mist, completely scattered.
冷えた身体には力が入らず、\n呼吸をするたび、胸の奥が鈍く痛んだ。:
No strength comes to my chilled body,
and with every breath, a dull ache echoes deep in my chest.
長期コールドスリープからの覚醒だと、\n理解するまでにさえ、しばらく時間が必要だ:
It took a moment just to process
that I was awakening from a long period of cold sleep.
起きてください！\n報告があります！:
Please wake up!
I have a report!
頭が全然働かない……\n長期コールドスリープってこういう感じなのか……:
My head isn't working at all...
Is this what waking up from long-term cold sleep feels like...?
肯定します。覚醒直後の混乱と倦怠感は、\n想定された生理反応の範囲内です。:
Affirmative. The disorientation and lethargy immediately following awakening
are within the expected range of physiological responses.
ですが、今は悠長に回復を待てません。\n目的地が見えてきました。:
However, we do not have the luxury to wait for your recovery.
Our destination has come into view.
そして、長期観測データの解析結果によれば──: And according to the analysis of the long-term observation data—
その後のイザナミの言葉を聞いて、俺は目を見開く。: Hearing Izanami's next words, my eyes widened.
彼女の一言で、胸の鼓動が急激に速くなり、\n霧に沈んでいた意識が一気に覚醒した。:
With that single sentence, my heart began to pound violently,
and my consciousness, previously submerged in fog, snapped fully awake.
約２０００年を越えた先にある目的地。\nその星に、待ち望んだ生命がいるという。:
Our destination, lying beyond nearly two thousand years of travel.
She said that on that planet, the life we had long hoped for exists.
俺はまだ覚束ない足を無理に動かし、\n壁へ手をつきながら、艦橋司令室へ急いだ。:
Forcing my still-unsteady legs into motion,
I placed a hand against the wall for support and hurried to the bridge command center.
司令室の扉が開くと、覚醒直後の静けさとは対照的な、\n異様な熱気とざわめきが俺を:
As the command center doors opened, I was greeted by an extraordinary heat and commotion,
a stark contrast to the silence immediately following my awakening.
各席では観測情報が絶え間なく更新され、\n士官達が数値と画像を声に出して確認して:
Observation data was being updated continuously at every station,
with officers calling out readouts and images aloud to verify them.
先に目覚めていた亜紗陽と士官達が、\n観測データを食い入るように見つめている。:
Asahi, who had awakened earlier, along with the other officers,
were staring intently at the observation data.
亜紗陽……いや、艦長！\n目的地を確認できたって本当か！？:
Asahi... I mean, Captain!
Is it true that we've confirmed our destination?!
しかも、そこには生命がいる可能性が高いって、\nイザナミから聞いた！:
And I heard from Izanami that
there's a high probability life exists there!
落ち着いて、まず呼吸を整えて。\n観測結果は有力だけど、まだ最終確認の途中です。:
Calm down, take a breath first.
The observation results are promising, but we are still in the middle of final verification.
でも、観測結果は、\n私達が夢見ていた可能性を示しています。:
However, the findings do point
toward the very possibility we've been dreaming of.
目的地の惑星まで、あとわずか。\n接近に合わせ、乗組員の覚醒が順次進められていた:
We are just a short distance away from our target planet.
As we approached, crew members were being awakened in sequence.
同時にイザナミは、\n長い航行中に蓄積した観測データを共有している。:
At the same time, Izanami was sharing
the observation data gathered over our long journey.
観測結果を提示します。\n目標星系、第四惑星の分析結果です。:
Presenting observation results.
These are the analysis findings for the fourth planet of the target star system.
大気と表面環境は、\n観測できる範囲で地球に極めて近いと推定されます。:
The atmosphere and surface conditions are estimated
to be extremely close to Earth within our observable range.
人類が移住先へ求めてきた条件に、\n限りなく近い惑星です。:
It is a planet that comes extraordinarily close
to the conditions humanity has sought in a colonization site.
昼夜や季節に相当する周期的な変化も、\n我々の理想から大きく外れる兆候はありませ:
The periodic shifts corresponding to day, night, and seasons
show no signs of deviating significantly from our ideal parameters.
まだ詳細な確定は避けるべきですが、\n地球型の環境に近い候補としては非常に有望で:
While we should refrain from making definitive statements just yet,
as a candidate possessing an Earth-like environment, it is exceptionally promising.
詳細の確定には、さらに観測が必要です。\n現段階では、包括的な評価に留めます。:
Further observation is required to confirm details.
At this stage, we shall limit ourselves to a comprehensive evaluation.
地球を知らない世代の俺達にとっても、\nどこか懐かしく見える、青く美しい惑星だっ:
Even to our generation who had never known Earth,
it was a beautiful blue planet that somehow looked nostalgic.
さらに生命活動を示す重要な兆候として、\n大気中に酸素とメタンが同時に存在してい:
Furthermore, as a vital indicator of biological activity,
oxygen and methane exist simultaneously within the atmosphere.
その二つがあるだけで、\n生命がいると分かるのか？:
Just having those two elements
is enough to know there's life?
単独で存在するだけなら、\n生命活動を意味するとは限りません。:
If either existed in isolation,
it would not necessarily imply biological activity.
ですが酸素とメタンは、\n本来互いに反応して減少する組み合わせです。:
However, oxygen and methane form a combination
that naturally reacts and depletes one another over time.
それが共存し続けている。\n何かが両方を、継続的に供給している証拠です。:
Yet they continue to coexist.
This is evidence that something is continuously supplying both.
つまり、化学反応だけでは維持できない物質が、\n惑星規模の代謝によって供給され続:
You mean substances that couldn't be maintained through chemical reactions alone
are being continuously supplied through planetary-scale metabolic processes...?
肯定します。炭素系生命圏が存在する確度は、\n９９．８％です。:
Affirmative. The probability of a carbon-based biosphere existing
is 99.8%.
確率が表示された瞬間、\n司令室は抑えきれないどよめきに包まれた。:
The moment the probability was displayed,
the command center was swept by an uncontrollable murmur.
何度も再計算された数値が、\nひとつの結論へ収束していく様子を全員が見守る。:
Everyone watched as the repeatedly calculated figures
converged toward a single conclusion.
期待だけではない。\n科学的な観測が、生命の存在を指し示していた。:
It wasn't merely hope.
Scientific observations were pointing directly to the existence of life.
生命だ……間違いなく、俺達とは異なる星で生まれた、\n本物の地球外生命なんだ……:
It's life... Without a doubt, real extraterrestrial life
born on a world different from ours...!
地球を発ってから、\n人類が一度も出会えなかった宇宙の隣人。:
A cosmic neighbor
whom humanity had never encountered since leaving Earth.
私達は今、その存在を、\n確かめようとしているのですね……！:
We are about to confirm its existence
right now, aren't we...!
長い間、宇宙で孤独だった人類は、\nひとりぼっちではなかったのかもしれない。:
Humanity, having been alone in space for so long,
might not have been truly alone after all.
人類が孤独ではないという可能性に、\n司令室にいる誰もが胸を熱くしていた。:
At the possibility that humanity was not alone,
every heart in the command center burned with excitement.
……でも、待ってくれ。\n生命がいるなら、好きに降りられるわけじゃない。:
...But wait a second.
If there's life, we can't just land as we please.
俺達の行動には、\n厳しい制約がかかるはずだ。:
There ought to be strict constraints
placed on our actions.
肯定します。生命圏の存在が確定した時点から、\n『異星生命接触規定』を適用します:
Affirmative. From the point a biosphere's existence is confirmed,
the 'Alien Life Contact Protocols' shall be applied.
生命を発見した喜びと入植を急ぐ都合は、\n明確に切り分けて判断しなければなりませ:
The joy of discovering life and the urgency of colonization
must be clearly separated in making our determinations.
別名、『第二知性保護憲章』ね。\n要点を、全員でもう一度確認しましょう。:
Otherwise known as the 'Secondary Intelligence Protection Charter.'
Let's review the main points together once more.
第一項。移住先に原生の生命圏を確認した場合、\n入植を前提とした行動は認められま:
Clause One: If a native biosphere is confirmed at the colonization destination,
no actions predicated on colonization shall be permitted.
直接接触と入植行為を停止し、\n直ちに長期観測へ移行しなければなりません。:
Direct contact and colonization activities must cease immediately,
and a transition to long-term observation must occur at once.
まずは直接接触を避け、\n長期観測で相手を知ることを優先するわけか。:
So first we avoid direct contact,
prioritizing getting to know them through long-term observation.
肯定します。生命圏の全容を把握する前に、\n不可逆な影響を与える事態を避けるため:
Affirmative. This is to avoid causing irreversible impacts
before fully understanding the scope of the biosphere.
現時点で直接接触を行えば、\n生命圏へ与える影響を予測できません。:
If direct contact were made at this stage,
the impact on the biosphere cannot be predicted.
第二項。独自の生態系や、\n未成熟な文明が存在する場合。:
Clause Two: If a unique ecosystem
or an immature civilization exists...
その惑星へ人類社会を持ち込む、\n恒久的な入植は禁止されます。:
...the introduction of human society to the planet
and permanent colonization are strictly prohibited.
文明の有無だけが基準ではありません。\n固有の生命圏そのものが、保護対象となりま:
The presence of civilization is not the sole criteria.
The native biosphere itself becomes a protected entity.
入植できないなら、\nこの船にいる全員はどうなる？:
If we can't colonize,
what happens to everyone on this ship?
軌道上での居住を維持し、\n他の天体から資源を確保します。:
We shall maintain orbital habitation
and harvest resources from other celestial bodies.
再航行が可能になれば、\n別の候補地を探すことも選択肢です。:
If re-navigation becomes feasible,
searching for another candidate destination remains an option.
つまり軌道上で暮らしながら資源を集め、\n再航行の可能性を探ることになるんだな。:
So we live in orbit while gathering resources,
and explore the possibility of setting sail again.
肯定します。人類の生存と生命圏の保護を両立できる、\n代替手段を優先します。:
Affirmative. We prioritize alternative means
that balance both human survival and biosphere protection.
まあ、先住する生命を押しのけることはできませんね。: Well, we certainly can't go pushing aside pre-existing life.
そして、第三項。\nこれらの最終決定権についてです。:
And Clause Three:
concerning the final authority for these decisions.
現地指揮官であるマスター『亜紗陽』に、\n判断とその結果への責任が委ねられます。:
The authority and responsibility for the decision and its outcomes
are entrusted to Master 'Asahi', the local commander.
表示された惑星を見つめながら、\n亜紗陽は静かに息を整えた。:
Staring at the displayed planet,
Asahi quietly steadied her breath.
地球文明を未来へ継承すること。\n異星生命を保護し、乗組員を生存させること。:
To pass human civilization on to the future.
To protect alien life and keep our crew alive.
そのすべてを考え、\n私が最終判断を下すということですね。:
Taking all of that into account,
it means I am the one who must make the final call.
声は静かだった。\nそれでも、背負う責任の重さははっきり伝わってきた。:
Her voice was quiet,
yet the weight of the responsibility she carried was clearly conveyed.
俺達も判断材料を集める。\n艦長ひとりだけに、全部を背負わせるつもりはない。:
We'll gather information for you to decide, too.
We won't let the captain shoulder everything alone.
……ありがとうございます。\nその言葉を、頼りにさせてもらいましょう。:
...Thank you.
I'll hold you to that promise.
肯定します。マスター『亜紗陽』の判断を、\n私は必要な情報で支援します。:
Affirmative. I shall support Master 'Asahi's'
decisions with all necessary information.
それにしてもこの規定が厳しい理由は、\n俺達の歴史にあるんだよな。:
Still, the reason these regulations are so strict
is because of our history, right?
その認識は正確です。\nこの規定は、人類が受けた被害の記憶から生まれました。:
That understanding is precise.
These regulations were born from the memory of the devastation humanity suffered.
かつて人類は地球に訪れた『災厄』に蹂躙され、\nその故郷を捨てることになりました:
Humanity was once overrun by the 'calamity' that arrived on Earth,
forcing us to abandon our homeworld.
外から来た存在が、\nその星の生命を一方的に踏みにじる。:
An entity from the outside
unilaterally trampling upon the life of that world.
私達は決して、\nその災厄――『やつら』と同じ行為を選択しません。:
We shall never choose to act
like that calamity—like 'them'.
それが生き延びた人類が自らに課した、\n最後の矜持です。:
That is the ultimate pride
that surviving humanity imposed upon itself.
……生き延びるためだとしても、\n俺達は『やつら』のようには、ならない。:
...Even if it's to survive,
we won't become like 'them'.
俺の言葉に、\n司令室の全員が静かにうなずいた。:
At my words,
everyone in the command center nodded silently.
期待に浮かれていても、\n越えてはいけない一線だけは忘れていない。:
Even amid the excitement of anticipation,
no one forgot the line that must never be crossed.
『やつら』に奪われた歴史を持つからこそ、\n人類は奪う側へ回ることを拒んだのだ。:
Precisely because we carried a history of having everything stolen by 'them,'
humanity refused to become the ones who steal.
亜紗陽が一歩前へ出る。\n艦長として、最初の決定を下すために。:
Asahi stepped forward
to make her first decision as captain.
観測と記録を始めるにあたり、\nこの惑星へ正式な呼称を与えます。:
As we commence observation and recording,
we shall assign a formal designation to this planet.
旅人の守護神ヘルメスが携える杖、\n『カドゥケウス』から名を取り──:
Taking its name from the Caduceus,
the staff carried by Hermes, guardian deity of travelers—
惑星『カデュシア』。\n私達が見つけた、宇宙の隣人の星です。:
Planet 'Caduceus'.
The world of our cosmic neighbor, discovered by us.
そして規定に従い、\nアマツカゼは長期観測段階へ移行します。:
And in accordance with regulations,
the Amatsukaze shall now transition to the long-term observation phase.
直接接触と入植は停止。\nまず、この星と生命圏の全容を把握します。:
Direct contact and colonization are suspended.
First, we shall ascertain the full picture of this planet and its biosphere.
観測結果は全乗組員へ共有し、\n今後の方針は十分な情報を得てから決定します。:
Observation findings will be shared with all crew members,
and future policy will be decided once sufficient information is obtained.
司令室に響いた返事には、\n失望ではなく高揚が満ちていた。:
The response echoing through the command center
was filled not with disappointment, but with excitement.
入植できないかもしれない。\nそれでも、未知の生命に出会えた喜びのほうが大きい。:
We might not be able to colonize.
Even so, the joy of encountering unknown life far outweighed that.
知的生命もいるんでしょうか！？\nどんな姿なのか、想像もできません！:
Do you think there's intelligent life, too?!
I can't even imagine what they might look like!
人類史に残る観測になるぞ！\n全部、見逃さず記録しよう！:
This observation is going to go down in human history!
Let's record everything without missing a single detail!
ははっ。歴史的な発見を前にしたら、\nみんな子供みたいにはしゃぐよな。:
Haha. Faced with a historical discovery,
everyone gets excited like kids.
かくいう俺も同じだ。\nワクワクが止まらない。:
And I'm no different.
I can't stop my heart from pounding with excitement.
ふふ……緊張ばかりだった船内が、\nこんなに明るい空気になるのは、いいわね。:
Fufu... It's wonderful to see the ship's atmosphere,
which used to be so tense, become so bright and lively.
暗く長い旅の果てに、\nこんな出会いが待っていたなんて。:
To think that at the end of a long, dark journey,
an encounter like this was waiting for us.
観測準備が完了しました。\n観測衛星群を射出します。:
Preparations for observation complete.
Deploying satellite array.
衛星群をカデュシアの周回軌道へ投入し、\n長期観測を開始します。:
Inserting the satellite array into Caduceus's orbit
to commence long-term observation.
アマツカゼの外殻が開き、\n無数の観測衛星が静かに放たれていく。:
The outer hull of the Amatsukaze opened,
and countless observation satellites drifted quietly out into space.
衛星群は青く美しい惑星へ向かい、\nその周回軌道へ次々と散らばっていった。:
The satellite array headed toward the beautiful blue planet,
scattering one after another into its orbital path.
――そして俺達はモニターの光を見つめながら、\n誰もがまだ……期待に胸を膨らませ:
—And as we gazed at the glow of the monitors,
every single one of us... was still swelling with anticipation.
